# SIMPLEXSTRONG

> > Strength training methodology inspired by George Hackenschmidt (the Russian Lion), focusing on fundamental principles of weight progression and training simplicity.

SIMPLEXSTRONG preserves and teaches the timeless strength training wisdom of George Hackenschmidt, one of history's greatest strongmen. The site provides practical lessons on starting weights, rep selection, and progressive overload based on early 20th century training principles.

## Key Topics

- Russian Lion (George Hackenschmidt)
- SIMPLEXSTRONG methodology
- Starting weight selection
- Rep selection strategies
- Weight progression protocols
- Strength training fundamentals
- Progressive overload
- Old-time strongman methods
- Training simplicity
- Classic strength principles

## Core Training Lessons

- [Russian Lion's SIMPLEXSTRONG Lessons: How to Choose Starting Weight, Reps, and How to Increase the Weight](https://simplexstrong.com/2017/01/russian-lions-simplexstrong-lessons-choose-starting-weight-reps-increase-weight): George Hackenschmidt's tips on starting weight, reps & progression
